cause: Both original functions close the parent before assigning the child to the cleanup variable. A synthetic close that releases the parent, reuses its fd for a foreign file, and raises proves foreign close and leaked child.
fix: Assign parent,directory = directory,child before closing parent. Cleanup then owns the child; foreign reused fd is untouched.
final_tests: Python3.12 and3.14: directory1 + identity22 + installed-environment11 each PASS;34 methods per version, including both directory-function subcases.
style_and_typing: Ruff0.15.20 format/check; mypy2.1 strict scoped3files follow-imports=silent PASS. No whole-repo claim.
residual: This fixes the demonstrated directory handoff. It does not guarantee arbitrary asynchronous failure handling or protect descriptors from unrelated concurrent closes.
